name: Iowa

agency.name: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing (DIAL) - Wage and Child Labor Unit

rates2026.note: Iowa Code 91D.1: $7.25 or the federal minimum, whichever is greater.

minWage.smallEmployer: The state minimum wage does not apply to most enterprises grossing under $300,000 a year (except laundries, construction, hospitals, schools and certain others); such employers may still be covered by the federal FLSA.

tipped.note: Employees receiving more than $30/month in tips: tip credit up to 40% of the minimum wage ($2.90); employer makes up any shortfall to $7.25.

minWage.other: New-hire wage: an employer may pay $6.35/hour until the employee completes 90 calendar days of employment (Iowa Code 91D.1(1)(d)); federal law may require $7.25 for FLSA-covered employers.

source.quote: The state hourly wage shall be at least $6.20 as of April 1, 2007, and $7.25 as of January 1, 2008.

overtime.exemptSalaryNote: No state overtime law; federal FLSA (40 h/week, $684/week exemption threshold) applies.
overtime.note: DIAL refers all overtime claims to the U.S. Department of Labor.

source.quote: If you believe you are owed overtime pay, contact the U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Office.

sickLeave.note: Iowa law does not require sick, vacation or holiday pay; employers must follow their own policies.

source.quote: Iowa Law does not require employers to provide sick time, vacation pay or holiday pay.

finalPay.fired: by the next regularly scheduled payday
finalPay.quit: by the next regularly scheduled payday
finalPay.ptoNote: Unused vacation is paid only if the employer has a contract, policy or procedure to pay it to departing employees.

source.quote: If you leave employment for any reason, you are to be paid on the next regularly scheduled payday.

ptoSource.quote: Only if the employer has a contract, policy or procedure to pay vacation to departing employees.

breaks.minorsOnly: Minors under 16 must get a 30-minute break if they work 5 hours or more in a day. All employees must be allowed toilet breaks when needed.

source.quote: Iowa has no laws mandating meal breaks for adults. ... Minors younger than 16 must be given a 30-minute break if they are employed five hours or more in a day.

rightToWorkSource.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person ... as a prerequisite to or a condition of employment to require any person to pay dues ... to any labor union

notes.text: Iowa's tip credit is capped at 40% of the minimum wage, so tipped workers get at least $4.35/hour in cash, double the federal $2.13.

source.quote: If you make $30 per month or more in tips, the employer may pay as little as $4.35 per hour.

notes.text: Iowa allows a lower $6.35 wage during an employee's first 90 calendar days with an employer.

source.quote: An employer shall pay an employee who has not completed ninety calendar days of employment ... at least ... $6.35 as of January 1, 2008.

notes.text: An employer must get the employee's written consent before mailing a paycheck.

source.quote: An employer must obtain an employee's written consent before a paycheck is sent via the mail.

uncertain: Local minimum wages: Iowa preempted local minimum-wage ordinances in 2017; the preemption statute was not read today, so localMinWages is empty without a cited source.
Small-employer exemption ($300,000) and the $6.35 90-day wage are state-law only; FLSA-covered employers must still pay $7.25.
